<?php
require __DIR__.'/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__.'/lib/UploadService.php';
require_once __DIR__.'/lib/PortalService.php';
require_once __DIR__.'/lib/FinanceOperations.php';
require_once __DIR__.'/lib/GeneralTreasuryAccountScope.php';
require_once __DIR__.'/lib/ExpenseReceiptService.php';
require_once __DIR__.'/lib/DepartmentTreasuryService.php';

$auth->requireAbility('finance');
$church=$auth->currentChurch();
if(!$church)redirect('/logout.php');
$cid=(string)$church['id'];
$uploader=new UploadService(__DIR__);
$financeOps=new FinanceOperations($pdo,$auth,$cid);
$financeRegistry=new RegistryService($pdo,$auth,$cid);
ExpenseReceiptService::ensureSchema($pdo);

$error=flash('error');
$success=flash('success');
$from=(string)($_GET['from']??date('Y-m-01'));
$to=(string)($_GET['to']??date('Y-m-d'));
if(!preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/',$from))$from=date('Y-m-01');
if(!preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/',$to))$to=date('Y-m-d');

function finance_money_input(mixed $value): float {
    $s=preg_replace('/[^0-9,.\-]/','',(string)$value)??'0';
    if(str_contains($s,','))$s=str_replace('.','',$s);
    return (float)str_replace(',','.',$s);
}
function finance_account_for(PDO $pdo,string $cid,?string $id): ?array {
    if(!$id)return null;
    $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM finance_accounts WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1');
    $q->execute([$id,$cid]);
    return $q->fetch()?:null;
}
function finance_document_type(string $value): string {
    $allowed=['fiscal_coupon','invoice','receipt','proof','contract','other'];
    return in_array($value,$allowed,true)?$value:'proof';
}
function finance_attach_document(
    PDO $pdo,
    UploadService $uploader,
    array $file,
    string $cid,
    ?string $entryId,
    ?string $payableId,
    string $type,
    ?string $number,
    ?string $issuedAt,
    ?string $notes,
    ?string $userId
): ?string {
    $stored=$uploader->financeDocument($file,$cid);
    if(!$stored)return null;
    $id=app_uuid();
    $q=$pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO finance_documents(id,church_id,entry_id,payable_id,document_type,document_number,issued_at,original_name,storage_path,mime_type,file_size,notes,created_by_user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)');
    $q->execute([
        $id,$cid,$entryId,$payableId,finance_document_type($type),$number?:null,$issuedAt?:null,
        $stored['original_name'],$stored['path'],$stored['mime'],$stored['size'],$notes?:null,$userId
    ]);
    return $id;
}

function finance_person(PDO $pdo,string $cid,array $input): ?string {
    $id=trim((string)($input['member_id']??''))?:null;
    if($id){
        $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM members WHERE church_id=? AND id=?');$q->execute([$cid,$id]);
        if(!$q->fetchColumn())throw new RuntimeException('Membro não encontrado nesta igreja.');
    }
    return $id;
}

if($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD']==='POST'){
    try{
        verify_csrf();
        $action=(string)($_POST['action']??'');

        if($action==='reverse_entry'){
            $id=trim((string)($_POST['id']??''));
            $reason=trim((string)($_POST['reason']??''));
            if($id===''||$reason==='')throw new RuntimeException('Informe o motivo do estorno.');

            $q=$pdo->prepare("SELECT id,status,transaction_date FROM finance_entries WHERE id=? AND church_id=? LIMIT 1");
            $q->execute([$id,$cid]);$entry=$q->fetch();
            if(!$entry)throw new RuntimeException('Lançamento não encontrado.');
            if($entry['status']!=='posted')throw new RuntimeException('Este lançamento já não está ativo.');
            FinancePeriodGuard::assertOpen($pdo,$cid,$entry['transaction_date']);

            $q=$pdo->prepare("UPDATE finance_entries SET status='reversed',reversed_at=NOW(),reversal_reason=?,reversed_by_user_id=? WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND status='posted'");
            $q->execute([$reason,$_SESSION['user_id']??null,$id,$cid]);
            if($q->rowCount()!==1)throw new RuntimeException('Não foi possível estornar o lançamento.');

            flash('success','Lançamento estornado sem apagar o histórico.');
            redirect('/finance.php');
        }

        if($action==='account'){
            $name=trim((string)($_POST['name']??''));
            $type=(string)($_POST['account_type']??'cash');
            $opening=finance_money_input($_POST['opening_balance']??0);
            if($name==='')throw new RuntimeException('Informe o nome da conta.');
            if(!in_array($type,['cash','bank'],true))throw new RuntimeException('Tipo de conta inválido.');
            $pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO finance_accounts(id,church_id,name,account_type,opening_balance,active) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,1)')
                ->execute([app_uuid(),$cid,$name,$type,$opening]);
            flash('success','Conta financeira criada.');
            redirect('/finance.php');
        }

        if($action==='entry'){
            $direction=(string)($_POST['direction']??'income');
            if(!in_array($direction,['income','expense'],true))throw new RuntimeException('Tipo inválido.');
            $amount=finance_money_input($_POST['amount']??0);
            $date=(string)($_POST['transaction_date']??date('Y-m-d'));
            $desc=trim((string)($_POST['description']??''));
            $category=trim((string)($_POST['category']??''));
            $accountId=trim((string)($_POST['account_id']??''))?:null;
            $counterparty=trim((string)($_POST['counterparty']??''))?:null;
            $paymentMethod=trim((string)($_POST['payment_method']??''))?:null;
            $documentNumber=trim((string)($_POST['document_number']??''))?:null;
            $notes=trim((string)($_POST['notes']??''))?:null;
            // Regras da lista de sugestões: dízimo identificado exige vínculo de membro;
            // o dízimo anônimo permanece permitido e não deve ser associado a terceiros.
            $identifiedTithe=($direction==='income' && preg_match('/d[ií]zimo/iu',$category)
                && (string)($_POST['tithe_identified']??'')==='1');
            if($identifiedTithe && trim((string)($_POST['member_id']??''))===''){
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Dízimo identificado: selecione o membro contribuinte antes de registrar.');
            }
            $usesBankReference=$direction==='income' && preg_match('/pix|transfer[êe]ncia/iu',$paymentMethod);
            if($usesBankReference && $documentNumber===''){
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe o ID Pix, autenticação ou referência bancária da entrada.');
            }
            // A conta define o caixa de destino. Caixas departamentais utilizam
            // o mesmo serviço e as permissões da Tesouraria dos Departamentos.
            $selectedAccount=finance_account_for($pdo,$cid,$accountId);
            if($accountId!==null&&$selectedAccount===null)
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Conta financeira inexistente ou inativa nesta igreja.');
            if(!empty($selectedAccount['department_id'])){
                if(!$auth->can('department_treasury'))
                    throw new RuntimeException('Seu perfil não pode movimentar caixas departamentais.');
                $departmentTreasury=new DepartmentTreasuryService($pdo,$auth,$cid,(string)$auth->requireLogin()['id']);
                $departmentId=(string)$selectedAccount['department_id'];
                $entryId=$departmentTreasury->createEntry($departmentId,$_POST,$_FILES['document_file']??[]);
                flash('success','Movimentação registrada no caixa do departamento e consolidada na igreja, sem duplicidade.');
                if($direction==='expense'&&in_array((string)($_POST['proof_method']??'upload'),['receipt_screen','receipt_print'],true))
                    redirect('/expense-receipt.php?entry='.rawurlencode($entryId));
                redirect('/finance.php');
            }
            GeneralTreasuryAccountScope::assertGeneral($pdo,$cid,$accountId);
            if($amount<=0||$desc===''||$category==='')throw new RuntimeException('Informe valor, categoria e descrição.');

            $proofMethod=(string)($_POST['proof_method']??'upload');
            $generateReceipt=$direction==='expense' && in_array($proofMethod,['receipt_print','receipt_screen'],true);
            if($generateReceipt){
                ExpenseReceiptService::validateInput($_POST);
                if((int)($_FILES['document_file']['error']??UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE)===UPLOAD_ERR_OK)
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException('Escolha anexar documento OU gerar recibo, não as duas opções.');
            }
            $financialRefs=$financeOps->references($_POST);
            $memberId=finance_person($pdo,$cid,$_POST);
            if($memberId&&$direction!=='income')throw new RuntimeException('O vínculo pessoal é usado somente para contribuições de entrada.');
            PortalService::date($date);
            FinancePeriodGuard::assertOpen($pdo,$cid,$date);
            $departmentId=null; // General cashier postings never inherit the donor's department.
            $entryId=app_uuid();
            $pdo->beginTransaction();
            try{
            $q=$pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO finance_entries(id,church_id,account_id,member_id,department_id,cost_center_id,contact_id,direction,category,description,amount,transaction_date,status,source,created_by_user_id,counterparty,payment_method,document_number,notes) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'posted','manual',?,?,?,?,?)");
            $q->execute([$entryId,$cid,$accountId,$memberId,$departmentId,$financialRefs['cost_center_id'],$financialRefs['contact_id'],$direction,$category,$desc,$amount,$date,$_SESSION['user_id']??null,$counterparty,$paymentMethod,$documentNumber,$notes]);

            if($generateReceipt){
                $service=new ExpenseReceiptService($pdo,$auth,$cid,(string)($auth->requireLogin()['id']));
                $service->create($entryId,$_POST);
            }else{
                finance_attach_document(
                    $pdo,$uploader,$_FILES['document_file']??[],$cid,$entryId,null,
                    (string)($_POST['document_type']??'proof'),$documentNumber,$date,$notes,$_SESSION['user_id']??null
                );
            }
            $pdo->commit();
            }catch(Throwable $failure){if($pdo->inTransaction())$pdo->rollBack();throw $failure;}
            flash('success',($direction==='income'?'Entrada':'Saída').' registrada no livro financeiro.'.
                ($generateReceipt?' Recibo vinculado à despesa.':''));
            if($generateReceipt)redirect('/expense-receipt.php?entry='.rawurlencode($entryId));
            redirect('/finance.php');
        }

        if($action==='attach_document'){
            $entryId=trim((string)($_POST['entry_id']??''))?:null;
            $payableId=trim((string)($_POST['payable_id']??''))?:null;
            if(!$entryId&&!$payableId)throw new RuntimeException('Selecione o lançamento ou a conta a pagar.');
            if($entryId){
                $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT 1 FROM finance_entries WHERE id=? AND church_id=?');$q->execute([$entryId,$cid]);
                if(!$q->fetchColumn())throw new RuntimeException('Lançamento inválido.');
            }
            if($payableId){
                $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT 1 FROM finance_payables WHERE id=? AND church_id=?');$q->execute([$payableId,$cid]);
                if(!$q->fetchColumn())throw new RuntimeException('Conta a pagar inválida.');
            }
            $docId=finance_attach_document(
                $pdo,$uploader,$_FILES['document_file']??[],$cid,$entryId,$payableId,
                (string)($_POST['document_type']??'proof'),
                trim((string)($_POST['document_number']??''))?:null,
                trim((string)($_POST['issued_at']??''))?:null,
                trim((string)($_POST['notes']??''))?:null,
                $_SESSION['user_id']??null
            );
            if(!$docId)throw new RuntimeException('Selecione um arquivo para anexar.');
            flash('success','Documento arquivado com segurança.');
            redirect('/finance.php');
        }

        if($action==='receipt'){
            $payer=trim((string)($_POST['payer_name']??''));
            $payerDoc=trim((string)($_POST['payer_document']??''))?:null;
            $amount=finance_money_input($_POST['amount']??0);
            $description=trim((string)($_POST['description']??''));
            $date=(string)($_POST['received_at']??date('Y-m-d'));
            $paymentMethod=trim((string)($_POST['payment_method']??''))?:null;
            $accountId=trim((string)($_POST['account_id']??''))?:null;
            $category=trim((string)($_POST['category']??'Ofertas'))?:'Ofertas';
            $notes=trim((string)($_POST['notes']??''))?:null;
            if($payer===''||$amount<=0||$description==='')throw new RuntimeException('Informe nome, valor e motivo do recibo.');
            GeneralTreasuryAccountScope::assertGeneral($pdo,$cid,$accountId);

            $financialRefs=$financeOps->references($_POST);
            $memberId=finance_person($pdo,$cid,$_POST);
            PortalService::date($date);
            FinancePeriodGuard::assertOpen($pdo,$cid,$date);
            $departmentId=null; // General cashier postings never inherit the donor's department.

            $pdo->beginTransaction();
            try{
                // Serializa a numeração por igreja para impedir recibos duplicados
                // quando dois usuários emitem ao mesmo tempo.
                $lockChurch=$pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM churches WHERE id=? FOR UPDATE');
                $lockChurch->execute([$cid]);
                if(!$lockChurch->fetchColumn())throw new RuntimeException('Igreja não encontrada.');

                $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(receipt_number),0)+1 FROM finance_receipts WHERE church_id=?');
                $q->execute([$cid]);$number=(int)$q->fetchColumn();
                $entryId=app_uuid();
                $pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO finance_entries(id,church_id,account_id,member_id,department_id,cost_center_id,contact_id,direction,category,description,amount,transaction_date,status,source,created_by_user_id,counterparty,payment_method,notes) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'income',?,?,?,?,'posted','receipt',?,?,?,?)")
                    ->execute([$entryId,$cid,$accountId,$memberId,$departmentId,$financialRefs['cost_center_id'],$financialRefs['contact_id'],$category,$description,$amount,$date,$_SESSION['user_id']??null,$payer,$paymentMethod,$notes]);

                $receiptId=app_uuid();
                $pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO finance_receipts(id,church_id,receipt_number,finance_entry_id,payer_name,payer_document,amount,description,payment_method,received_at,notes,created_by_user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)')
                    ->execute([$receiptId,$cid,$number,$entryId,$payer,$payerDoc,$amount,$description,$paymentMethod,$date,$notes,$_SESSION['user_id']??null]);
                $pdo->commit();
            }catch(Throwable $e){if($pdo->inTransaction())$pdo->rollBack();throw $e;}

            flash('success','Recibo nº '.str_pad((string)$number,6,'0',STR_PAD_LEFT).' emitido e entrada registrada.');
            redirect('/finance.php?receipt='.rawurlencode($receiptId));
        }

        if($action==='payable'){
            $supplier=trim((string)($_POST['supplier']??''));
            $desc=trim((string)($_POST['description']??''));
            $amount=finance_money_input($_POST['amount']??0);
            $due=(string)($_POST['due_date']??'');
            $accountId=trim((string)($_POST['account_id']??''))?:null;
            $documentNumber=trim((string)($_POST['document_number']??''))?:null;
            $notes=trim((string)($_POST['notes']??''))?:null;
            GeneralTreasuryAccountScope::assertGeneral($pdo,$cid,$accountId);
            if($supplier===''||$desc===''||$amount<=0||$due==='')throw new RuntimeException('Preencha fornecedor, descrição, valor e vencimento.');

            $payableId=app_uuid();
            $pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO finance_payables(id,church_id,account_id,supplier,description,amount,due_date,status,document_number,notes) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'open',?,?)")
                ->execute([$payableId,$cid,$accountId,$supplier,$desc,$amount,$due,$documentNumber,$notes]);

            finance_attach_document(
                $pdo,$uploader,$_FILES['document_file']??[],$cid,null,$payableId,
                (string)($_POST['document_type']??'invoice'),$documentNumber,null,$notes,$_SESSION['user_id']??null
            );

            flash('success','Conta a pagar cadastrada.');
            redirect('/finance.php');
        }

        if($action==='mark_paid'){
            $id=(string)($_POST['id']??'');
            $pdo->beginTransaction();
            try{
                $q=$pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM finance_payables WHERE id=? AND church_id=? FOR UPDATE");$q->execute([$id,$cid]);$p=$q->fetch();
                if(!$p)throw new RuntimeException('Conta a pagar não encontrada.');
                $paidDate=(string)($_POST['paid_at']??date('Y-m-d'));
                FinancePeriodGuard::assertOpen($pdo,$cid,$paidDate);
                $oldEntry=$pdo->prepare('SELECT transaction_date FROM finance_entries WHERE church_id=? AND payable_id=?');$oldEntry->execute([$cid,$id]);$oldDate=$oldEntry->fetchColumn();
                if($oldDate)FinancePeriodGuard::assertOpen($pdo,$cid,(string)$oldDate);
                if($p['status']==='paid')throw new RuntimeException('Esta conta já está paga.');
                GeneralTreasuryAccountScope::assertGeneral($pdo,$cid,(string)($p['account_id']??''));
                $pdo->prepare("UPDATE finance_payables SET status='paid',paid_at=? WHERE id=? AND church_id=?")->execute([$paidDate,$id,$cid]);
                $entryId=app_uuid();
                $q=$pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO finance_entries(id,church_id,account_id,direction,category,description,amount,transaction_date,status,source,payable_id,created_by_user_id,counterparty,document_number,notes)
                    VALUES(?,?,?,'expense','Contas a pagar',?,?,?,'posted','payable',?,?,?,?,?)
                    ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_id=VALUES(account_id),description=VALUES(description),amount=VALUES(amount),transaction_date=VALUES(transaction_date),status='posted',counterparty=VALUES(counterparty),document_number=VALUES(document_number),notes=VALUES(notes)");
                $q->execute([$entryId,$cid,$p['account_id']??null,$p['supplier'].' - '.$p['description'],$p['amount'],$paidDate,$p['id'],$_SESSION['user_id']??null,$p['supplier'],$p['document_number']??null,$p['notes']??null]);
                $pdo->commit();
            }catch(Throwable $e){if($pdo->inTransaction())$pdo->rollBack();throw $e;}
            flash('success','Conta paga e saída registrada no livro financeiro.');
            redirect('/finance.php');
        }

        if($action==='budget'){
            require_once __DIR__.'/lib/BudgetService.php';
            (new BudgetService($pdo,$auth,$cid))->save($_POST);
            flash('success','Orçamento salvo.');
            redirect('/finance-budget.php');
        }

        if($action==='close_period'){
            $periodType=(string)($_POST['period_type']??'daily');
            if(!in_array($periodType,['daily','monthly'],true))throw new RuntimeException('Tipo de fechamento inválido.');
            $reference=(string)($_POST['reference_date']??date('Y-m-d'));
            if(!preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/',$reference))throw new RuntimeException('Data de fechamento inválida.');
            $accountId=trim((string)($_POST['account_id']??''))?:null;
            if($accountId&&!finance_account_for($pdo,$cid,$accountId))throw new RuntimeException('Conta financeira inválida.');
            $notes=trim((string)($_POST['notes']??''))?:null;

            $periodStart=$periodType==='monthly'?date('Y-m-01',strtotime($reference)):$reference;
            $periodEnd=$periodType==='monthly'?date('Y-m-t',strtotime($reference)):$reference;

            if($accountId){
                $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT opening_balance FROM finance_accounts WHERE id=? AND church_id=?');
                $q->execute([$accountId,$cid]);
                $opening=(float)$q->fetchColumn();

                $q=$pdo->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='income' AND status='posted' THEN amount WHEN direction='expense' AND status='posted' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END),0) FROM finance_entries WHERE church_id=? AND account_id=? AND transaction_date<?");
                $q->execute([$cid,$accountId,$periodStart]);
                $opening+=(float)$q->fetchColumn();

                $q=$pdo->prepare("SELECT
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='income' AND status='posted' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0) income,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='expense' AND status='posted' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0) expense
                    FROM finance_entries WHERE church_id=? AND account_id=? AND transaction_date BETWEEN ? AND ?");
                $q->execute([$cid,$accountId,$periodStart,$periodEnd]);
            }else{
                $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(opening_balance),0) FROM finance_accounts WHERE church_id=? AND active=1');
                $q->execute([$cid]);
                $opening=(float)$q->fetchColumn();

                $q=$pdo->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='income' AND status='posted' THEN amount WHEN direction='expense' AND status='posted' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END),0) FROM finance_entries WHERE church_id=? AND transaction_date<?");
                $q->execute([$cid,$periodStart]);
                $opening+=(float)$q->fetchColumn();

                $q=$pdo->prepare("SELECT
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='income' AND status='posted' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0) income,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='expense' AND status='posted' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0) expense
                    FROM finance_entries WHERE church_id=? AND transaction_date BETWEEN ? AND ?");
                $q->execute([$cid,$periodStart,$periodEnd]);
            }

            $totals=$q->fetch()?:['income'=>0,'expense'=>0];
            $incomeTotal=(float)$totals['income'];
            $expenseTotal=(float)$totals['expense'];
            $closingBalance=$opening+$incomeTotal-$expenseTotal;

            $pdo->beginTransaction();
            try{
                $lock=$pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM churches WHERE id=? FOR UPDATE');
                $lock->execute([$cid]);
                if(!$lock->fetchColumn())throw new RuntimeException('Igreja não encontrada.');

                $sql='SELECT id FROM finance_closings WHERE church_id=? AND period_type=? AND period_start=? AND period_end=? AND ';
                $params=[$cid,$periodType,$periodStart,$periodEnd];
                if($accountId){$sql.='account_id=?';$params[]=$accountId;}else{$sql.='account_id IS NULL';}
                $q=$pdo->prepare($sql.' LIMIT 1');
                $q->execute($params);
                $existingId=$q->fetchColumn();

                if($existingId){
                    $q=$pdo->prepare('UPDATE finance_closings SET opening_balance=?,income_total=?,expense_total=?,closing_balance=?,notes=?,closed_by_user_id=?,closed_at=NOW() WHERE id=? AND church_id=?');
                    $q->execute([$opening,$incomeTotal,$expenseTotal,$closingBalance,$notes,$_SESSION['user_id']??null,$existingId,$cid]);
                    $closingId=(string)$existingId;
                }else{
                    $closingId=app_uuid();
                    $q=$pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO finance_closings(id,church_id,account_id,period_type,period_start,period_end,opening_balance,income_total,expense_total,closing_balance,notes,closed_by_user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)');
                    $q->execute([$closingId,$cid,$accountId,$periodType,$periodStart,$periodEnd,$opening,$incomeTotal,$expenseTotal,$closingBalance,$notes,$_SESSION['user_id']??null]);
                }
                $pdo->commit();
            }catch(Throwable $e){if($pdo->inTransaction())$pdo->rollBack();throw $e;}

            flash('success','Fechamento '.($periodType==='monthly'?'mensal':'diário').' salvo. Saldo final: R$ '.number_format($closingBalance,2,',','.').'.');
            redirect('/finance.php?closing='.rawurlencode($closingId));
        }

        if($action==='reconcile'){
            $accountId=(string)($_POST['account_id']??'');
            $account=finance_account_for($pdo,$cid,$accountId);
            $date=(string)($_POST['reference_date']??date('Y-m-d'));
            $statement=finance_money_input($_POST['statement_balance']??0);
            if(!$account)throw new RuntimeException('Selecione uma conta financeira.');
            $q=$pdo->prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction='income' AND status='posted' THEN amount WHEN direction='expense' AND status='posted' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END),0) FROM finance_entries WHERE church_id=? AND account_id=? AND transaction_date<=?");
            $q->execute([$cid,$accountId,$date]);
            $system=(float)$account['opening_balance']+(float)$q->fetchColumn();
            $diff=$statement-$system;
            $status=abs($diff)<0.005?'reconciled':'open';
            $q=$pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO finance_reconciliations(id,church_id,account_id,reference_date,statement_balance,system_balance,difference_amount,status) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE statement_balance=VALUES(statement_balance),system_balance=VALUES(system_balance),difference_amount=VALUES(difference_amount),status=VALUES(status)');
            $q->execute([app_uuid(),$cid,$accountId,$date,$statement,$system,$diff,$status]);
            flash('success',$status==='reconciled'?'Conciliação fechou sem diferença.':'Conciliação salva com diferença de R$ '.number_format($diff,2,',','.').'.');
            redirect('/finance.php');
        }
    }catch(Throwable $e){
        Ui::rememberPost('finance.php');
        flash('error',$e->getMessage());

/**
 * Tema multi-igreja: cores e logo são sempre obtidos da igreja autenticada.
 * Nunca usar esses valores para selecionar ou acessar outra igreja.
 */
final class TenantBranding
{
    public const PRIMARY = '#0D47A1';
    public const SECONDARY = '#1976D2';

    public static function color(mixed $value, string $fallback = self::PRIMARY): string
    {
        $value = strtoupper(trim((string)$value));
        return preg_match('/^#[0-9A-F]{6}$/D', $value) ? $value : $fallback;
    }

    public static function validateColor(mixed $value, string $label): string
    {
        $value = strtoupper(trim((string)$value));
        if (!preg_match('/^#[0-9A-F]{6}$/D', $value)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe uma cor hexadecimal válida em '.$label.'.');
        }
        return $value;
    }

    private static function luminance(string $hex): float
    {
        $channels = [];
        for ($i = 1; $i <= 5; $i += 2) {
            $v = hexdec(substr($hex, $i, 2)) / 255;
            $channels[] = $v <= 0.04045 ? $v / 12.92 : pow(($v + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
        }
        return $channels[0] * 0.2126 + $channels[1] * 0.7152 + $channels[2] * 0.0722;
    }

    public static function validatePrimary(mixed $value): string
    {
        $color = self::validateColor($value, 'Cor principal');
        // Os botões usam texto branco; preservar legibilidade WCAG AA.
        if (1.05 / (self::luminance($color) + 0.05) < 4.5) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Escolha uma cor principal mais escura para manter os textos legíveis.');
        }
        return $color;
    }

    public static function normalize(?array $church): array
    {
        $church ??= [];
        $primary = self::color($church['brand_primary'] ?? null, self::PRIMARY);
        // A cor legada inválida nunca entra em CSS sem validação.
        if (1.05 / (self::luminance($primary) + 0.05) < 4.5) $primary = self::PRIMARY;
        return [
            'name' => trim((string)($church['name'] ?? '')) ?: 'Igreja Master',
            'logo' => trim((string)($church['logo_url'] ?? '')),
            'primary' => $primary,
            'secondary' => self::color($church['brand_secondary'] ?? null, self::SECONDARY),
            'tagline' => trim((string)($church['brand_tagline'] ?? '')),
        ];
    }

    /** Inline declarations with strictly hexadecimal values; still HTML-escape on output. */
    public static function style(?array $church): string
    {
        $theme = self::normalize($church);
        return '--church-primary:'.$theme['primary'].';--church-secondary:'.$theme['secondary'].';';
    }
}

    public function __construct(private PDO $pdo) {}

    public static function parseAmount(mixed $raw): string
    {
        $s = preg_replace('/\s|R\$/u', '', trim((string)$raw)) ?? '';
        if (preg_match('/^[0-9]{1,3}(?:\.[0-9]{3})+(?:,[0-9]{1,2})?$/D', $s)) {
            $s = str_replace(',', '.', str_replace('.', '', $s));
        } elseif (preg_match('/^[0-9]{1,8}(?:,[0-9]{1,2})?$/D', $s)) {
            $s = str_replace(',', '.', $s);
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^[0-9]{1,8}(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?$/D', $s)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe um valor válido em reais.');
        }
        $value = (float)$s;
        if ($value <= 0 || $value > 99999999.99) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O valor precisa ser positivo e dentro do limite.');
        }
        return number_format($value, 2, '.', '');
    }

    public function enable(string $churchId, bool $enable): void
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,contribution_quick_token FROM churches WHERE id=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$churchId]);
        $church = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$church) throw new RuntimeException('Igreja inválida.');
        if ($enable) {
            $this->seedCatalog($churchId);
            $token = $church['contribution_quick_token'] ?: bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
            $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE churches SET contribution_quick_enabled=1,contribution_quick_token=? WHERE id=?')
                ->execute([$token,$churchId]);
        } else {
            $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE churches SET contribution_quick_enabled=0 WHERE id=?')
                ->execute([$churchId]);
        }
    }

    public function rotateToken(string $churchId): void
    {
        $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE churches SET contribution_quick_token=? WHERE id=?')
            ->execute([bin2hex(random_bytes(32)), $churchId]);
    }

    public function seedCatalog(string $churchId): void
    {
        $types = [
            ['dizimo','Dízimo',0,0],['oferta','Oferta',0,0],
            ['missoes','Missões',0,0],['campanha','Campanha',0,1],
            ['doacao','Doação',0,0],['outro','Outro',0,0],
        ];
        $payments = [
            ['pix','Pix',1,0],['dinheiro','Dinheiro',0,0],
            ['transferencia','Transferência',1,0],['cartao','Cartão',0,0],
        ];
        $sql = 'INSERT IGNORE INTO contribution_catalog(id,church_id,kind,code,name,requires_reference,requires_campaign,sort_order) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)';
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        foreach (['type'=>$types,'payment'=>$payments] as $kind=>$rows) {
            foreach ($rows as $i=>$r) {
                $stmt->execute([app_uuid(),$churchId,$kind,$r[0],$r[1],$r[2],$r[3],$i]);
            }
        }
    }

    public function catalog(string $churchId,string $kind): array
    {
        if (!in_array($kind,['type','payment'],true)) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Lista inválida.');
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,code,name,requires_reference,requires_campaign FROM contribution_catalog WHERE church_id=? AND kind=? AND active=1 ORDER BY sort_order,name');
        $stmt->execute([$churchId,$kind]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function campaigns(string $churchId, ?string $date = null): array
    {
        $date ??= date('Y-m-d');
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,name FROM contribution_campaigns WHERE church_id=? AND active=1 AND start_date<=? AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date>=?) ORDER BY name');
        $stmt->execute([$churchId,$date,$date]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function addCampaign(string $churchId,array $input): string
    {
        $name = trim((string)($input['name']??''));
        $start = (string)($input['start_date']??'');
        $end = trim((string)($input['end_date']??'')) ?: null;
        self::date($start);
        if ($end !== null) self::date($end);
        if ($name===''||mb_strlen($name)>160||($end!==null&&$end<$start)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe nome e datas válidos da campanha.');
        }
        $id=app_uuid();
        $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO contribution_campaigns(id,church_id,name,start_date,end_date,active) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,1)')
            ->execute([$id,$churchId,$name,$start,$end]);
        return $id;
    }

    private static function date(string $date): void
    {
        $d=DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d',$date);
        if (!$d || $d->format('Y-m-d')!==$date) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe uma data válida.');
    }

    public function publicChurch(string $token): ?array
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D',$token)) return null;
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,name,logo_url,brand_primary,brand_secondary,brand_tagline,contribution_quick_token FROM churches WHERE contribution_quick_token=? AND contribution_quick_enabled=1 AND active=1 LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$token]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: null;
    }

    private function item(string $churchId,string $kind,string $id): array
    {
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,code,name,requires_reference,requires_campaign FROM contribution_catalog WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND kind=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$id,$churchId,$kind]);
        $row=$stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$row) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Tipo ou forma de entrega inválida nesta igreja.');
        return $row;
    }

    /**
     * Public submission only reports an intention/contribution.
     * It does NOT credit the treasury before human confirmation.
     */
    public function submit(array $church,array $input,array $file,UploadService $upload,?string $memberId=null,?string $userId=null): array
    {
        $cid=(string)$church['id'];
        $key=trim((string)($input['request_key']??''));
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D',$key)) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Atualize o formulário e tente novamente.');
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM contribution_requests WHERE church_id=? AND request_key=?');
        $stmt->execute([$cid,$key]);
        if ($existing=$stmt->fetchColumn()) return ['id'=>$existing,'already'=>true];
        if (trim((string)($input['website']??''))!=='') throw new InvalidArgumentException('Envio inválido.');

        $date=trim((string)($input['transaction_date']??date('Y-m-d')));
        self::date($date);
        $today=date('Y-m-d');
        if ($date>$today || $date<date('Y-m-d',strtotime('-7 days'))) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Escolha hoje ou até sete dias anteriores.');
        }
        $value=self::parseAmount($input['amount']??'');
        $type=$this->item($cid,'type',trim((string)($input['type_id']??'')));
        $payment=$this->item($cid,'payment',trim((string)($input['payment_id']??'')));
        $reference=trim((string)($input['bank_reference']??''));
        if ($payment['requires_reference'] && $reference==='') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe a referência do Pix ou da transferência.');
        }
        if (mb_strlen($reference)>190) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Referência muito longa.');
        $campaignId=trim((string)($input['campaign_id']??''))?:null;
        if ($type['requires_campaign'] && !$campaignId) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Selecione uma campanha vigente.');
        $campaignName='';
        if ($campaignId!==null) {
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT name FROM contribution_campaigns WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND active=1 AND start_date<=? AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date>=?)');
            $stmt->execute([$campaignId,$cid,$date,$date]);
            $campaignName=(string)$stmt->fetchColumn();
            if ($campaignName==='') throw new InvalidArgumentException('Campanha não está vigente nesta igreja.');
        }

        $name=trim((string)($input['contributor_name']??''));
        $notes=trim((string)($input['observation']??''));
        if (mb_strlen($name)>190 || mb_strlen($notes)>250) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Nome ou observação excedeu o limite.');
        $ip=(string)($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']??'unknown');
        $ipHash=hash_hmac('sha256',$ip,$church['contribution_quick_token']);
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contribution_requests WHERE church_id=? AND ip_hash=? AND created_at>=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 1 HOUR)');
        $stmt->execute([$cid,$ipHash]);
        if ((int)$stmt->fetchColumn()>=5) throw new RuntimeException('Limite temporário de envios atingido. Procure a Tesouraria.');

        $stored=$upload->financeDocument($file,$cid);
        $requestId=app_uuid();
        $entryId=app_uuid();
        $desc='Contribuição informada para conferência: '.$type['name'].($campaignName!==''?' - '.$campaignName:'');
        $desc=mb_substr($desc,0,255);
        if ($memberId!==null) {
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM members WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([$memberId,$cid]);
            if (!$stmt->fetchColumn()) $memberId=null;
        }
        $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO finance_entries(id,church_id,account_id,member_id,direction,income_kind,category,description,amount,transaction_date,status,source,created_by_user_id,payment_method,notes) VALUES(?,?,NULL,?,'income',?,?,?,?,?,'received','member_qr',?,?,?)");
            $stmt->execute([$entryId,$cid,$memberId,$type['code'],$type['name'],$desc,$value,$date,$userId,$payment['code'],$notes?:null]);
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO contribution_requests(id,church_id,finance_entry_id,request_key,contribution_type_id,payment_method_id,campaign_id,contributor_name,bank_reference,observation,ip_hash) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)');
            $stmt->execute([$requestId,$cid,$entryId,$key,$type['id'],$payment['id'],$campaignId,$name?:null,$reference?:null,$notes?:null,$ipHash]);
            if ($stored!==null) {
                $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO finance_documents(id,church_id,entry_id,payable_id,document_type,original_name,storage_path,mime_type,file_size,created_by_user_id) VALUES(?,?,?,NULL,'proof',?,?,?,?,?)");
                $stmt->execute([app_uuid(),$cid,$entryId,$stored['original_name'],$stored['path'],$stored['mime'],$stored['size'],$userId]);
            }
            $this->event($cid,$requestId,'submitted',null,'received',$userId,null);
            $this->pdo->commit();
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->pdo->inTransaction()) $this->pdo->rollBack();
            if ($stored!==null && is_file($stored['absolute'])) @unlink($stored['absolute']);
            throw $e;
        }
        return ['id'=>$requestId,'already'=>false];
    }

    public function pending(string $churchId): array
    {
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("SELECT r.*,e.amount,e.transaction_date,e.category,e.description,e.payment_method,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_documents d WHERE d.church_id=r.church_id AND d.entry_id=r.finance_entry_id) proof_count
            FROM contribution_requests r
            JOIN finance_entries e ON e.id=r.finance_entry_id AND e.church_id=r.church_id
            WHERE r.church_id=? AND r.status IN('received','reviewing')
            ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 250");
        $stmt->execute([$churchId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    public function entry(string $churchId,string $requestId): ?array
    {
        $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT r.*,e.amount,e.transaction_date,e.category,e.description,e.payment_method,e.status ledger_status FROM contribution_requests r JOIN finance_entries e ON e.id=r.finance_entry_id AND e.church_id=r.church_id WHERE r.id=? AND r.church_id=? LIMIT 1');
        $stmt->execute([$requestId,$churchId]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: null;
    }

    private function event(string $cid,string $id,string $action,?string $from,string $to,?string $user,string|null $comment): void
    {
        $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO contribution_events(id,church_id,request_id,action,from_status,to_status,actor_user_id,comment) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)')
            ->execute([app_uuid(),$cid,$id,$action,$from,$to,$user,$comment]);
    }

    public function review(Auth $auth,string $cid,string $requestId,string $action,array $input): void
    {
        if (!$auth->can('finance') || (string)($auth->currentChurch()['id']??'')!==$cid) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Sem permissão para conferir contribuições.');
        }
        if (!in_array($action,['reviewing','reject','post'],true)) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Ação inválida.');
        $user=(string)$auth->requireLogin()['id'];
        $note=trim((string)($input['reviewer_notes']??''));
        if (mb_strlen($note)>1000) throw new InvalidArgumentException('Observação de até 1.000 caracteres.');
        $item=$this->entry($cid,$requestId);
        if (!$item || !in_array($item['status'],['received','reviewing'],true)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Solicitação não encontrada ou já finalizada.');
        }
        if ($action==='reject' && $note==='') throw new InvalidArgumentException('Informe o motivo da devolução.');
        $accountId=null;$depId=null;$costCenterId=null;
        if ($action==='post') {
            if ((string)($input['confirmed_received']??'')!=='yes') {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Confirme que o valor foi efetivamente localizado no caixa ou no extrato.');
            }
            $accountId=trim((string)($input['account_id']??''));
            if ($accountId==='') throw new InvalidArgumentException('Selecione a conta ou o caixa de destino.');
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id,department_id FROM finance_accounts WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND active=1 LIMIT 1');
            $stmt->execute([$accountId,$cid]);
            $account=$stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$account) throw new RuntimeException('Conta inexistente, inativa ou de outra igreja.');
            $depId=$account['department_id'] ?: null;
            if ($depId!==null && !$auth->can('department_treasury')) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Este usuário não pode confirmar movimentações departamentais.');
            }
            $costCenterId=trim((string)($input['cost_center_id']??''))?:null;
            if ($costCenterId!==null) {
                $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("SELECT id FROM church_registers WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND kind='cost_center' AND active=1");
                $stmt->execute([$costCenterId,$cid]);
                if (!$stmt->fetchColumn()) throw new RuntimeException('Centro de custo não pertence a esta igreja.');
            }
            FinancePeriodGuard::assertOpen($this->pdo,$cid,(string)$item['transaction_date']);
        }

        $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('SELECT status,finance_entry_id FROM contribution_requests WHERE church_id=? AND id=? FOR UPDATE');
            $stmt->execute([$cid,$requestId]);$row=$stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            if (!$row || !in_array($row['status'],['received','reviewing'],true)) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Solicitação já processada.');
            }
            $from=(string)$row['status'];
            $status=$action==='post'?'approved':($action==='reject'?'rejected':'reviewing');
            $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE contribution_requests SET status=?,reviewed_by_user_id=?,reviewed_at=NOW(),reviewer_notes=? WHERE id=? AND church_id=?');
            $stmt->execute([$status,$user,$note?:null,$requestId,$cid]);
            if ($action==='post') {
                $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE finance_entries SET status='posted',account_id=?,department_id=?,cost_center_id=? WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND status='received'");
                $stmt->execute([$accountId,$depId,$costCenterId,$row['finance_entry_id'],$cid]);
                if ($stmt->rowCount()!==1) throw new RuntimeException('O lançamento já foi processado.');
            } elseif ($action==='reject') {
                $stmt=$this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE finance_entries SET status='rejected' WHERE id=? AND church_id=? AND status='received'");
                $stmt->execute([$row['finance_entry_id'],$cid]);
                if ($stmt->rowCount()!==1) throw new RuntimeException('O lançamento já foi processado.');
            }
            $this->event($cid,$requestId,$action,$from,$status,$user,$note?:null);
            $this->pdo->commit();
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->pdo->inTransaction()) $this->pdo->rollBack();
            throw $e;
        }
    }
